newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU exporters get 417,585T flour licences at refund.
newsitem.headline: EU exporters get 417,585T flour licences at refund.

text.p: Flour exporters took out European Union licences this week for 417,585 tonnes with export refunds of five Ecus per tonne, member country officials said.
The bids, which were accepted by the Commission on Thursday, bring the amount of flour booked for export since April 9 to 452,839 tonnes.
The quantity is based on flour value and has an equivalent soft wheat grain value of 620,389 tonnes.
Flour export licences are valid until June 30.
